errors.evidence: The y-axis has no scale, tick marks, or labels. The entire description of the y-axis, including its range, intervals, and specific labeled values, is fabricated.

errors.text_span: Линията започва при 4238 през 2012 г. и намалява до 4120 през 2013 г., след което постепенно се увеличава до 4674 през 2016 г. След това следва спад до 4382 през 2015 г. и достига връх от 5562 през 2017 г. В края на периода линията намалява до 4631 през 2022 г.
errors.evidence: This entire description incorrectly assigns data points from the 'Жилищни' (Residential) and 'Други' (Other) lines to the 'Административни' (Administrative) line. The actual values for the Administrative line are much lower, ranging from 70 to 187.
The value for the orange 'Други' (Other) line in 2022 is 4631. The value 4685 corresponds to the year 2021.
The line representing 'Жилищни' (Residential) is gray, not brown.
The 'Жилищни' (Residential) line starts at 4238 in 2012. The value 4245 corresponds to the year 2014 for that same line.
The maximum value for the 'Жилищни' (Residential) line is 8169, which occurs in 2022. The value 7047 corresponds to the year 2021.
